crossRefs.note: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of fools gush out folly.
Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.
For as a dream comes with a multitude of cares, so a fool’s speech with a multitude of words.
Yes also when the fool walks by the way, his understanding fails him, and he says to everyone that he is a fool.
A fool also multiplies words. Man doesn’t know what will be; and that which will be after him, who can tell him?

translations.web: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.
translations.bsb: Even a fool is considered wise if he keeps silent, and discerning when he holds his tongue.
translations.kjv: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.
translations.asv: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise; When he shutteth his lips, he is esteemed as prudent.
